title: Is it a valid AVL tree?

tests.name: Duplicate value
tests.hint: The template doesn't allow duplicates, so a repeated value makes the tree invalid.

tests.name: Bad value deep in the right subtree
tests.hint: 45 is in 50's right subtree, so it has to be bigger than 50. Pass the allowed range down.

tests.name: Balanced at the root only
tests.expr: is_valid_avl(build_tree([50, 30, 70, 20, None, 60, 80, 10, None, None, None, None, 90]))

tests.name: Every balance factor is +1
tests.expr: is_valid_avl(build_tree([3, 2, 5, 1, None, 4, 6, None, None, None, None, None, 7]))

tests.name: Large tree, one value out of place
tests.data:
root = balanced_tree(0, 20000)
node = root.left
while node.right.right:
    node = node.right
node.right.value = root.value + 1
tests.hint: A node deep in the left subtree is bigger than the root.

tests.name: Large tree, unbalanced deep down
tests.data:
root = balanced_tree(0, 16383)
node = root
while node.left:
    node = node.left
node.left = Node(-1, Node(-2))
